title: Wonderful
text: Wonderful. I  originally Got this to put in my cabinets for the packets To be organized I also Decided to use 1 in my spice cabinet I can just pull the basket out With the spices in them Instead of raffling around moving all the little bottles on the shelf. Make the storage so much easier.

product_metadata.title: JAKAGO Slim Plastic Storage Basket Pack of 3 Shelf Basket with Non-slip Handles Storage Bin for Home Office Rectangular Organizer box for Nursery Bedroom Bathroom Kitchen
features: 【Perfect Size for Storage】10.83”x4.33”x4.92”/27.5x11x12.5 cm. This slim size fits in anywhere in your room, including drawer, classroom, cupboard, pantry space, closet, cabinets, under sinks, cupboard, making full use of the narrow space.
【Sturdy But Not Chunky】This storage basket is made of high quality PP plastic, which is very durable and won’t deform. It is sturdy but light-weighted. It is also very easy to clean.
【Vetilation Design】The Perforation pattern design provides good vetilation and resists moisture. The holes allow you to easily see what’s in the basket.
【Easy to Move】The build-in handles on two sides of the storage bin makes it very easy to lift and carry. The handles are non-slip thanks to the raised dots on the top.
【Widely Used】With the slim size and practical design, this storage has a wide range of use. It holds various of things, like snacks, medicines, makeups, toiletries, books and so on.
